summary: Reviewed subject 4d2f548b12421b5ac430fcd4d40a63273ad0ce98 against frozen specification 04844c642eb64465cf26b8b9b37ba14b0bc09b75de678108aded6666b3ccbacf. The change was examined through four independent lenses (ignore-rule contract, agent entry-file contract, specification conformance, and interaction with what TASK-0034 and TASK-0035 already landed on main), and every finding was put to an adversarial verifier instructed to refute it. Eleven findings were raised and ten were refuted. The one that survived was material and is fixed in this subject: the first implementation commit asserted only the positive direction of the ignore contract plus two unrelated extensions, so no assertion was a function of a task record's name and the .json, .jsonl and .yaml families holding the ledger were unguarded; appending *.json to .gitignore hid evidence.json and approvals.json while every shipped test still passed. Because the specification names that direction as both an acceptance condition and an error behavior, closing it implements the frozen spec rather than widening scope. Two complementary guards now cover it: representative ledger paths must not be ignored, which catches a narrow rule such as /.ai/tasks/*/evidence.json, and the ledger extensions must not appear in .gitignore at all, which catches a broad one; the first was confirmed in a scratch repository to flip to ignored under exactly that narrow rule, so the guard demonstrably bites. The four added ignore rules are all root-anchored and git check-ignore confirms representative generated paths are ignored while every representative audit artefact is not. AGENTS.md is now the single shared authority with CLAUDE.md reduced to a linking adapter, and the entry-file test enforces that link. Re-applying the content onto current main preserved REC-09, REC-10 and TASK-0034's REC-11 in the recovery manual, and the clean-checkout assertion over the REC-01..REC-08 heading set still holds. Changes stay inside allowed_scope, scope validation passes, and V1 verification passed all ten required checks including the full regression suite, 85 percent total coverage and 90 percent diff coverage. No src/aiflow runtime path, Policy document, evidence schema, Gate rule, CI configuration or existing task record is touched.
